NYR.head: The Rangers start a half-step ahead
NYR.body: Utah has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately, but they are on the second night of a back-to-back, and the Rangers have home-ice advantage. The Mammoth can still swing it if they keep shots to a minimum.

UTA.head: The Mammoth start a half-step behind
UTA.body: Utah has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately, but they are on the second night of a back-to-back, and the Rangers have home-ice advantage. The Mammoth’s best way to tip it is keeping shots to a minimum.
